GraceTechnology.Language: JavaScript ESM, SQL, HTML/CSS and shell
GraceTechnology.Runtime: Node.js 24 LTS; Bun is allowed only for the engineering GRACE CLI
GraceTechnology.Framework: Node.js HTTP API and worker, SQLite with FTS5, browser UI, systemd services
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: node:test, Playwright, smoke tests, backup/restore selftests, offline bundle and systemd deployment selftests
GraceTechnology.Observability: Structured application logs, audit records, worker job state, GitHub Actions checks and immutable GRACE verification artifacts

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Production/runtime dependencies must remain offline-capable on Debian and Astra Linux.
GRACE and Bun are development/CI dependencies and must not enter the application runtime bundle.
Use existing project libraries and repository patterns before introducing a new dependency.
